Question Choices: Each batch of cookies requires 1 3/4 cups of sugar. A bakery uses 3 1/2 batches to fulfill an order. How many cups of sugar do they use in total?
Hints: How many cups are in 3 1/2 batches? Multiply cups per batch by number of batches.
Solution: 6 1/8. One batch has 1 3/4 cups. Multiply by 3 1/2 so 1 3/4 x 3 1/2 = (7/4) x (7/2) = 49/8 = 6 1/8
